notice_en: Basira-authored screening task, not standardized. Raw score only; no norms apply.
format_source: Mirror-discrimination format after Houbben & Vannuscorps (2022, GCPN Mons); items newly drawn by Basira. Supplementary only: reversals alone never indicate dyslexia.

blocks.instructions_en: Is this letter written the usual way, or as its mirror image?
